text:
zoe: quick follow-up from the cache outage: propose a compact follow-up workflow so items don't linger. 3 buckets: triage(0-24h), remediation(1-14d), validate(14-30d). owners rotate every 2 weeks. thoughts? :mag:

pete: +1. suggest these SLAs: triage summary within 3h, remediation plan in 48h, validation scheduled within 7d.

maya: agree. also add a required one-line 'next-step' at top of postmortem so reviewers see the immediate action.

jules: for tracking, a single board with columns triage / in-progress / validating / done. each card must have owner + due date + recurrence tag {none,suspect,confirmed}.

zoe: rotation idea: followup IC covers remediation ownership during their 2-week window. oncall IC handles triage. schedule published to #people-ops.

pete: automation: when recurrence-confirmed -> auto-create "deep-dive" ticket and assign senior owner. recurrence-suspect -> assign followup IC and add reminder every 3 days.

oncall-bot: created task https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-4100 and scheduled a reminder in 72h. :white_check_mark:

zoe: action items: jules -> prototype board (due 3d), pete -> add recurrence fields to template (48h), maya -> publish rotation + calendar invite (EOW). I'll draft the 1-page playbook.

maya: +1

jules: starting prototype now, will post link in thread when ready.

pete: updating template today.

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: followup owners check-in in 72h (thread 1755555555).

zoe: closing thread for now, will attach playbook to RI-4100 and reopen when board is live. thanks!
